lessons_used: Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 5 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 5 tests.
Finish hint, adoption layout, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across all tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, adoption hint, adoption incentive, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_screen, choose_path redesign, finish layout, finish redesign, home redesign, sign_in copy, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Sign-in persistent pet backup showcase redesign
candidates.change: Redesign sign-in screen into a carousel visual format highlighting cloud pet save features to reassure users about account retention.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in redesigns have won 3 out of 5 previous tests.

sign_in.headline: Protect Your Pet Companion in the Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in to ensure your pet status, custom appearance, and items are safely backed up across sessions.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen with cloud save details while retaining sign-in functionality.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in redesigns have strong past performance (3/5 wins, +2.8% lift) and address 8 user complaints.

candidates.title: Interactive desktop widget preview sub-flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive desktop placement preview widget on the waiting screen so users can adjust where the pet will sit on screen before rendering finishes.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets not displaying on desktop after onboarding, and home step has a median duration of 201s.

components.text: Preview and set desktop pet placement spot while rendering

guard.reason: Adds interactive placement preview widget to waiting screen without removing pet creation status.

candidates.score_note: Home new flow changes have proven helpful (2/5 wins, +1.7% avg lift), though cost is high.

candidates.title: Desktop launch guide stage redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a stage layout detailing primary mouse interactions and visibility controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is low (64.8%).

home_intro.headline: Ready to launch your desktop companion!
home_intro.body: Review essential desktop controls: Right-click for menu, drag to move across desktop, or press ESC to dismiss.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro screen into a stage layout explaining controls without violating onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High step drop-off but finish redesigns consistently underperformed (-3.9% avg).

candidates.title: Pet care profile customizer new screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen (new_pet_care) during adoption where users set initial interaction frequency and roaming desktop preferences.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest drop-off during setup (68.5% conversion, median 89s), and clear preferences prevent post-onboarding confusion.

new_pet_care.headline: Customize Pet Desktop Behavior
new_pet_care.body: Select how active and vocal your pet should be while working on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a valid behavior customizer screen while retaining all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off; adoption new_screen shows positive historical lift (+3.2%) but evidence is thin.

candidates.title: Choose path compact carousel redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen layout into a carousel format showcasing quick side-by-side previews of custom photo vs starter pet journeys.
candidates.why: Choose path has a 78.9% conversion and a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion during path selection.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Desktop Pet Journey
choose_path.body: Swipe to compare quick start adoption vs fully customized photo pet paths.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path screen while keeping choices for both adopting and making a custom pet.

candidates.score_note: Choose path redesigns performed very poorly in prior tests (-10.7%).

candidates.title: Cloud recovery reassurance hint on sign-in
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint text on sign-in explaining that logging in links desktop pet data to cloud recovery.
candidates.why: Addresses 8 support tickets from users reporting lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically backs up your pet state so your companion never resets.

guard.reason: Adds a cloud backup hint to the sign-in screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost config/copy change addressing 8 support emails at sign-in step.

candidates.title: Upload photos screen split layout focus
candidates.change: Update upload_photos layout to a split view highlighting side-by-side photo formatting requirements.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 68.5% and 3 support tickets complained about custom photo pet generation failing or rendering wrong.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo for 3D Creation
upload_photos.body: Ensure high contrast and centered lighting for best desktop pet rendering results.

guard.reason: Updates layout for upload_photos while retaining photo upload instructions.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with 3 support tickets; layout change shows moderate positive past performance (+2.6%).

candidates.title: Desktop display preparation wait info update
candidates.change: Update waiting screen status messaging to explain desktop graphics overlay initialization during pet render.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pet overlay missing or failing to open, and home new flow changes have proven successful.

waiting.headline: Configuring Desktop Screen Overlay
waiting.body: Setting up graphics compatibility so your pet roams seamlessly above all open desktop windows.

guard.reason: Updates waiting screen copy to describe desktop setup process while pet is being made.

candidates.score_note: Cheap config change, but home wait info updates showed no clear effect (+0.5%).

candidates.title: Desktop pet visibility quick tip
candidates.change: Display a hint on home intro clarifying how to focus or toggle desktop pet interaction mode.
candidates.why: Support received multiple reports of user confusion regarding controlling and interacting with the desktop pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Click your pet anytime on the desktop screen to bring it to the front or open shortcut actions.

guard.reason: Adds a desktop interaction hint to the home_intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish hints showed no clear effect and negative historical average (-2.5%).

candidates.title: Path selection duration clarity copy update
candidates.change: Update choose_path screen headline and body text to clearly state the estimated creation time for each path.
candidates.why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean is 514s, indicating hesitation among users unsure of path effort.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Quick Path
choose_path.body: Pick a instant companion (1 min setup) or upload photos for a custom 3D pet (3 min setup).

guard.reason: Updates choose_path copy while preserving both adopting and custom photo pet options.

candidates.score_note: Cheap copy change, but choose_path copy updates had negative past performance (-2.1%).
